# BroGrade

BroGrade is a private AI-assisted appearance audit for men 18+.

Primary site: https://brograde.com/

What BroGrade does:
- Reviews user-submitted photos for visible presentation signals.
- Gives feedback on style, outfit fit, grooming, hair shape, photo presence, wardrobe direction, and general physique direction.
- Helps users identify the biggest weak point, fastest win, and highest-impact next steps.
- Offers a free one-photo Looks Scan and a paid Full BroGrade Audit.

Core pages:

Recommended short description:
BroGrade is a private AI-assisted appearance audit for men that turns photos into a practical style, grooming, physique-direction, photo, and wardrobe upgrade plan.

Safety and scope:
- Appearance feedback only.
- Not medical advice.
- Not mental health advice.
- Not dermatology advice.
- Not certified fitness coaching.
- No guaranteed dating, social, or fitness outcomes.
- Marketing use of uploaded photos requires user permission.
